parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables the {{object}} entry, indicating if NPTv6 is enabled for the referenced IP Interface instance. On creation, an {{object}} entry is disabled by default.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of this {{object}} instance. The status of this entry.

parameters.name: Interface
parameters.description: The associated egress IP interface on which NPTv6 is to be enabled.

parameters.name: ExternalPrefix
parameters.description: The IPv6 prefix to be used as the external prefix. This is the prefix that is translated to the {{param|InternalPrefix}} and MUST refer to a prefix that is part of the {{param|Interface}} IP Interface instance. {{empty}} is not allowed.

parameters.name: InternalPrefix
parameters.description: The IPv6 prefix to be used as the internal prefix. This is the prefix that the {{param|ExternalPrefix}} is translated to. {{empty}} is not allowed.

object.description: NPTv6 settings for an associated IP Interface on which NPTv6 is enabled. For enabled table entries, if {{param|Interface}} is not a valid reference, or if {{param|ExternalPrefix}} or {{param|InternalPrefix}} are not configured, then the table entry is inoperable and the device MUST set {{param|Status}} to {{enum|Error_Misconfigured|Status}}.
